verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth is an authentication service. An auth product could plausibly offer autonomous background workflows, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no user-configurable automations or recurring scheduled jobs. Auth hooks (Postgres functions at lifecycle points) and database triggers run only in response to auth events. They are developer building blocks, not a background automation capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
